ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, the line $ l_{1}: y = x + 1 $ intersects with the line $ l_{2}: y = mx + n $ at the point $ P(a, 2) $. What is the solution set of the inequality $ x + 1 \ge mx + n $ with respect to $x$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since the line $l_{1}\colon y=x+1$ intersects with the line $l_{2}\colon y=mx+n$ at point P$(1,2)$,\\
$\therefore a+1=2$,\\
Solving this gives: $a=1$,\\
Observing the graph, we know that the solution set of the inequality $x+1\geq mx+n$ with respect to $x$ is $\boxed{x\geq 1}$.
